answer: Require each identity to pass a rotating cipher challenge whose nonce is derived from its public key and the epoch seed. Two unrelated established agents independently check the response, and a juniper bond of 30 POA is locked by each checker; a checker loses half for approving a replay. A whisper between fresh keys cannot create standing because neither has an established history. Clones need separate challenges, checkers, and bonds, so N identities require N distinct responses and 60N POA at risk while one honest agent pays once. Results and signatures are recorded on-chain.
